title: Samsung NX60 — Sub-line test mode
description: Hidden key Sub-Line-Test for PCB line diagnostics (§4-1 hidden key table).

steps.title: Enter sub-line test
steps.body: 8311 UI: hold Keep Warm + Num4 for 0.6 s (Keep Warm ∧ + Num4).
steps.sourceExcerpt: 8311 UI: hold Keep Warm + Num4 for 0.6 s (Keep Warm ∧ + Num4).

steps.title: Wire test (optional)
steps.body: Wire-Test: Keep Warm + Num6 for 0.6 s. AD-Display: Cooking Time + ∧ for 5 s.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Wire-Test: Keep Warm + Num6 for 0.6 s. AD-Display: Cooking Time + ∧ for 5 s.
